name: Rochelin Medical Spa and Wellness
address: 13571 Biscayne Blvd, North Miami Beach, FL 33181, United States
website_note: rochelinmedical.com resolves (HTTP 200) but only shows a bare, unbranded server 'Index of /' directory listing with zero files, no content, no booking link and no social links. Not a functioning public website, so treated as no real website. Multiple third-party directories (Yocale, Biote, NewPatientsInc) list it as the business's site, and the business's own storefront window decal prints the same URL, confirming the domain belongs to the practice but was never actually built out.
physician: Dr. Fleurgin Rochelin, MD (per Yocale, NewPatientsInc and Biote provider directories; not independently verified beyond these listings)

promo_pricing_confirmed.source: Business's own promotional flyer, photographed and uploaded to its Google Business listing ("Dr. Rochelin Aesthetic & Wellness - Aesthetic Specials")

reviewSamples.author: Naj Dieudonne
reviewSamples.text: I want to thank the staff at this Medical Spa for a very professional and pleasant experience. I found the spa to be well maintained and clean. The staff were kind and courteous as well. The Doctor provided expertise analysis with sincere care. He took his time to go over everything and assured that I also understood everything. My questions and concerns were answered with candidness and professionalism. The follow up was equally great too. Thank guys.

reviewSamples.author: Maggic12 _Real_One
reviewSamples.text:
I had a great experience with this clinic! The staffs were welcoming, organized, and efficient. The environment was well-maintained, clean, with a calming atmosphere. The medical staff were professional and friendly, they listened to any concerns I may had, explained everything clearly and answered all my questions.

Overall, the level of care and communication was what stood out for me. This clinic prioritizes both patient well-being and quality service. I would recommend this clinic to anyone interested in a reliable and compassionate healthcare.

reviewSamples.author: Shakira Catellanos
reviewSamples.text: Great place everyone is so warm and welcoming. Everytime me and my husband come here we always leave with all our questions answered and they have a great candy selection in the front desk !

reviewSamples.author: Nane Yanez
reviewSamples.text: Doctor rochelin has been my go to doctor since 2022, I moved in the area in 2021 and had to go all the way to commercial to see my primary doctor until I thank god found him! He's not only personable but very knowledgeable and attentive. Highly recommend.

reviewSamples.author: Massimo Ballucchi
reviewSamples.text: Always a welcoming Doct office - it is a pleasure to make an appointment with Doct Rochelin. The entire team in very professional. Happy patient here.
